referenceVersion: tvOS 27 Apple TV 4K user guide, observed 2026-09-28
method: Apple Support pages and linked screenshots rendered in Playwright. Proportions and colors are visual estimates from raster screenshots, not computed CSS or native tvOS tokens.

observed: A single full-bleed featured image occupies most of the first viewport
The title, metadata, short copy and a white play pill sit low and left
Small pagination marks sit below the hero
Continue Watching begins at the bottom edge of the hero
screens.jellyfinMapping: Home native shelves; optional userscript adds a featured carousel from the signed-in user's own items.

observed: A narrow translucent dark sidebar overlays the hero
The focused row becomes a bright rounded pill
Profile and time are above the navigation items
The underlying artwork remains visible through the panel
screens.jellyfinMapping: Style the existing Jellyfin drawer and its real destinations; retain search, user, administration and casting controls.

observed: Large search prompt across the upper region
Browse categories and results appear as widely spaced art tiles below
Focused input/control is brighter than the surrounding dark field
screens.jellyfinMapping: Style Jellyfin's native search field, suggestions and results; do not mimic the tvOS on-screen keyboard in a web text input.

observed: Matte charcoal background
Categories occupy a slim left rail
Selected category is a white pill
Poster art is arranged in an open grid without heavy card containers

inferredProportions.posterGap: about one fifth of a poster width

screens.jellyfinMapping: Use real Jellyfin library tabs and filters; mobile keeps them as horizontal chips.

observed: Cinematic image remains the dominant background
Logo or large title, metadata, summary and compact actions align low-left
The main play action is white and secondary actions are translucent circles
Episode artwork peeks below the hero
screens.jellyfinMapping: Use Jellyfin's backdrop, clear logo, native play/watchlist actions, metadata, seasons and episodes with text and poster fallbacks.

observed: Episode or related artwork is a horizontal row immediately below details
Rows use generous negative space and let images carry the visual weight
screens.jellyfinMapping: Keep native season selection and episode actions while making episode imagery and titles readable at desktop and mobile widths.

observed: Controls are concentrated in a low translucent strip
Episode kicker and title appear above a thin full-width timeline
Time labels and audio/subtitle actions remain legible
Controls disappear during uninterrupted playback
screens.jellyfinMapping: Only restyle Jellyfin's native video OSD; do not alter playback timing, track state, control visibility or subtitle settings.

releaseBoundary: Links and written observations may be public. Apple screenshot files, branded imagery, logos and fonts are not distributed.
